title: Daily Trip Week
rules: Highest Daily Trip score from 12 to 18 Oct (UTC) wins 1 SOL, paid from the team's own funds. Free to enter: sign in with a wallet before you play, and your best Daily Trip run of the week counts. A tie goes to whoever scored it first. Team wallets can play but can't win: the prize goes to the highest community wallet. Holders score a boost on every cast in every run: +10% for owning a REALM being and +10% for each $DMT band held (50k, 250k, 1M, 5M, 10M), up to x1.6. Playing stays free for everyone.
